data.title: 霍尔海雅 · 露台上的晚风
data.description: 夜风掀起披肩，她回头按住衣角，故意让出栏杆旁的空位。“靠近一点，”她说，“这里听得清楚。”
data.action: 回头按住披肩，朝镜头勾唇微笑
data.lighting: 室内漏出的暖光与夜色
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Leaning against an ornate marble balustrade on an elevated terrace under the star-filled Columbia night sky, Ho'olheyak catches her dark silk shawl as evening breezes ruffle her green hair and feather plumes. She glances over her bare shoulder with a captivating, secretive smirk, while glittering city tower lights and neon ribbons spread across the vast skyline below.
